owner_instruction: Create a better sculpted all-carbon monocoque study using explicit hypotheses.

reference_images.observation: Rolling assembly: shaped central cell, raised rear shoulders, tunnel, upper frame and separate front/rear running gear.
CAD-like tub surface view: rounded stepped floor pockets and integrated longitudinal channel; viewing orientation uncertain.
CAD-like underside view: shaped twin floor bays, varying centre channel and rounded perimeter; viewing orientation uncertain.
Side view: recessed door aperture, deep sill/return, raked windscreen and raised rear region; separate front module.
Seller overlay states 65 kg raw weight; weighing method, included hardware and exact revision are unknown.
Front view: shaped bulkhead, service/panel regions and separate front structure; no measurable anchor coordinates.
Rear outer bodywork shown separately from central cell and running gear.
Front outer clamshell shown separately from central cell and running gear.
Side architecture: continuous upper frame over deep curved door opening and front/rear transitions.

design_consequences: Author continuous shaped floor/tunnel/sill/scuttle/rear surfaces instead of repeating F1 rectangular panels.
Provide raked upper load paths with explicit physical and numerical junctions. All-carbon upper structure is an owner design intent, not an observed reference material.
Keep running gear, outer body and front/rear module packaging proxies separate from the structural cell and its mass/FEA scope.
Retain null physical mating coordinates, donor transform and installed shift mechanism until admissible data exists.
Do not use the 65 kg screenshot claim as an accepted weighing result or as a proof of product superiority.
